name: Koharu
source:
A polite, cheerful young woman. Having lived by herself for most of her life, she often forgets her own name as it’s been so long since she’s heard it.

In order to better assimilate with the others and not be disliked, she immersed herself in books about social etiquette and basic manners.

She has the ability to control fire. She is the most powerful of all the espers in her group and takes great care to hide that fact from the others.

The routes of Senri, Masamune, and Kakeru are only accessible when the player selects Koharu as the protagonist.

[From [url=http://aksysgames.com/norn9/characters/]English official site[/url]]
